headline: President Bush assigned his science and technology advisory council to also serve as the national advisory panel on nanotechnology.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13226, which set up the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. It gives that council the added job of serving as the National Nanotechnology Advisory Panel. No separate panel is created. The title does not give details about the panel's specific duties.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
who_it_affects.how: They take on the added role of advising the federal government on nanotechnology.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 23, 2004; the effective date is not stated in the title.
